title: Does rutent permit VOS's AGPL-3.0-or-later licence?
lead: Adopting VOS needs your licence decision recorded in licences/RECORD, case by case, with no counsel step (DEC-6).
bullets: At vos-core 5c78975, the re-score's commit, 12 VOS crates are AGPL-3.0-or-later and 14 are Apache-2.0 (the re-score's lockfiles; the first run at 1aadf44 counted 11 and 14).

The re-score's lockfiles need 277 lines in all; licences/RECORD now lists every package the experiment locks, VOS's AGPL crates permitted for the experiment (DEC-6,counsel-licences), the rest permitted standing.
Needed only if VOS was chosen on exp1-adopt-runtime: this item makes the experiment's permission the adoption's.
No VOS code reaches main as rutent's runtime until this decision is recorded.
options: Permit it for VOS's AGPL-3.0-or-later crates
Decline it; VOS stays not adopted
